title: Zero-point drives work as time machines

tellings.quote: Michael Masters goes into this in his book on UFOs and time travel which I cite in closer encounters

plain: An engine running on 'zero-point' energy, the energy some physicists say is present even in empty space, would also work as a time machine, according to the idea Jason Jorjani explains. Jorjani, a philosopher, tells Michels the argument comes from a book on UFOs and time travel by the author Michael Masters, which Jorjani cites in his own book Closer Encounters. If true, craft that use such drives could be travelling through time as well as through space.
